column7: follow-up to stale-user-profile-write-001 (#2653): once UpdateUserIfActiveStateMatches stopped writing account_state, the SCIM lifecycle paths (UpdateSCIMUser deactivate/reactivate, DeprovisionSCIMUser) persisted it only through the blind SetAccountState (WHERE id = ?), so a SuspendUser committing between their read and write was overwritten (reactivation -> active). Fixed by SetAccountStateIfMatches conditioned on the pre-read state. Found by C-RACE-FIX-B review of #2664
